dedupe_keys.name: deflex german and european energy dispatch model

description: deflex is a configurable Python energy-system dispatch model with German and European applications. Its developers publish the package, documentation and a versioned Zenodo DOI. Users supply demand, generation, fuel and technology data and choose system constraints; the model optimises dispatch across the represented sectors and time steps. Outputs are flows, generation schedules and analysis tables for the configured scenario. Geographic coverage depends on the selected German or European case, and temporal resolution follows the input series. MIT-licensed code is freely available. A limitation is that a dispatch result does not by itself prove future investment choices, and cross-sector outcomes depend on consistent input datasets. The package can support electricity and heat-operation or transition scenarios. The catalogue's model-pypsa-eur is another European energy model, but its implementation and underlying assumptions are distinct. No packaged input set or solver was run.
inputs: Sectoral demand, generation and technology series
name: deflex German and European energy dispatch model
